addresses_location_ck.name: addresses_location_ck
addresses_location_ck.value: ("addresses"."latitude" is null) = ("addresses"."longitude" is null) and ("addresses"."latitude" is null or ("addresses"."latitude" between 6 and 37.6 and "addresses"."longitude" between 68 and 97.5))

coupons_kind_ck.name: coupons_kind_ck
coupons_kind_ck.value: ("coupons"."kind" = 'percent' and "coupons"."percent_bps" between 1 and 10000 and "coupons"."amount_paise" is null) or ("coupons"."kind" = 'fixed' and "coupons"."amount_paise" > 0 and "coupons"."percent_bps" is null)
